_comment: Rename to config.json to use. Every value below is the built-in default.
_machine_comment: Extra building layers inside a platform. Hard-clamped so the top layer stays at or below 19 (a building layer is SafeMod(tile.z, 20)); the default 17 is all of that room. Only layers 0-2 can carry a port to another platform - see DESIGN.md.
_space_comment: Extra platform layers in space, added above the current topmost one. Hard-clamped so the top layer stays at or below 999; anything asked for past that is logged and dropped.
_policy_comment: How the player earns them. Shop = buy them, Granted = have them all from the first frame, None = they exist but nothing unlocks them (for another mod to drive).
_shop_comment: Shop policy only. Each tier list is the level each purchase ends at: [3, 10, 19] sells level 3, then 4-10, then 11-19; levels past the last end are one more purchase. An empty list [] sells LayersPerShopEntry layers per purchase instead. Costs are per purchase: the first costs the base, each later one CostGrowthFactor times the one before.
_diagnostic_comment: Both of these change something the building and blueprint shaders read per layer. Turn one off at a time to find which is responsible for a shading problem on high floors; a mod drawing with its own material is unaffected by either.
_hud_comment: The game's layer strip grows nine pixels per layer and runs off screen around thirty. This rescales it to fit, and does nothing while it already fits.
_key_repeat_comment: Seconds a layer up/down key must be held before it repeats; it then speeds up the longer it is held. 0 turns it off.
_jump_comment: Selecting a single platform or building on another layer moves the view to that layer.
_overview_step_comment: Space layers moved per layer key press when fully zoomed out. 0 picks a tenth of the unlocked range (about 100 at 999 layers).
_hud_number_comment: Above this many layers the strip shows the current layer's number instead of one handle per layer. 0 never switches.
_saves_comment: Lets a save made without this mod be opened with it. Removing the mod from a save that has used it is still refused by the game.
